notes.title: Regular Update
notes.content: [h2]Changes[/h2][p]  [/p][p]Fixed a regression that caused pixel alignment to be done incorrectly, resulting in more jerky motion than intended.  Additionally, added options for target frame rate and V-Sync in Settings menu.[/p][p]Added a new camera style option that allows off center view.  The original camera style is available as an option in the Settings menu.[/p][p]Changed the behaviors of several enemy types.  This improves the variety among enemies and helps make early stages more engaging.[/p][p]Rebalancing pass on enemies and early spell progression. This improves the consistency of the early game (and generally makes the first few stages easier).[/p][p]Player collision detecting has been adjusted to always be the minimum possible size regardless of character and facing.  This makes the collision detection consistent and mostly impacts dodging of enemy projectiles.[/p][p]Second boss no longer summons additional waves of enemies while some still exist.  This reduces the possibility of the player being overwhelmed and always gives a chance to deal damage to the boss after dealing with the summons.[/p][p]Added several new spell aspects, and upgrades to aspects that previously did not have any special upgrades.[/p][p]Added several new talents.[/p][p]Added one more unique item.[/p][p]Spells now indicate if there are any available aspects that can be added to them.[/p][p]Many improvements and fixes to various spells.[/p][p]Reworked the Brutality spell aspect.[/p][p]Reduced the damage dealt by apparitions created by delusion.[/p][p]...and more content not visible in demo.[/p]

tags.bug: Fixed a regression that caused pixel alignment to be done incorrectly, resulting in more jerky motion than intended.

tags.feature: Additionally, added options for target frame rate and V-Sync in Settings menu.
Added a new camera style option that allows off center view.
The original camera style is available as an option in the Settings menu.

tags.balance_change: Changed the behaviors of several enemy types.
Rebalancing pass on enemies and early spell progression.
Player collision detecting has been adjusted to always be the minimum possible size regardless of character and facing.
Second boss no longer summons additional waves of enemies while some still exist.

tags.feature: Added several new spell aspects, and upgrades to aspects that previously did not have any special upgrades.
Added several new talents.
Added one more unique item.
Spells now indicate if there are any available aspects that can be added to them.

tags.bug: Many improvements and fixes to various spells.

tags.balance_change: Reworked the Brutality spell aspect.
Reduced the damage dealt by apparitions created by delusion.

notes.title: New Feature + minor patch
notes.content: [h2]New Feature - Codex[/h2][p][/p][p]The Codex is a new feature accessible through the main menu that allows you to view most of the possible choices available in the game - only choices that you have previously picked in the past will be fully revealed, so that you can both track what you have tried out before and review the descriptions and stats of the various spells, aspects, talents, etc.[/p][p][/p][h2]Patch notes[/h2][list][*][p]Added the Codex to the main menu, which allows you to view various categories of choices made and their descriptions[/p][/*][*][p]Spell are automatically bound to a free slot if possible when learning them[/p][/*][*][p]Many fixes to the set of new spells added last patch[/p][/*][*][p]Miscellaneous visual and audio improvements[/p][/*][*][p]New visuals for trees, as the previous visual was not clear what it was[/p][/*][*][p]Added interface option to set a fixed field of view [/p][/*][*][p]Objectives now are more obvious and show their type when they first appear[/p][/*][*][p]Improved behavior of spell levelups when gaining multiple levels at once[/p][/*][*][p]Blood Magic spell aspect no longer has "Cannot be applied to remedy spells" and instead has "This spell cannot restore life in any way"[/p][/*][*][p]Slayer's Advance buff now only applies to non-translocation spells[/p][/*][*][p]You can now view the full details of spells granted by shrines by expanding the effect description in the character sheet[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: Added the Codex to the main menu, which allows you to view various categories of choices made and their descriptions
Added interface option to set a fixed field of view

tags.bug: Many fixes to the set of new spells added last patch

tags.balance_change: Blood Magic spell aspect no longer has "Cannot be applied to remedy spells" and instead has "This spell cannot restore life in any way"

notes.title: Regular Update
notes.content:
[h2]Major changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added support for Vulkan and D3D12 GPU drivers, and selection of GPU driver can be changed in the settings menu
[*] Added 8 new spells
[*] Many numerical adjustments to game mechanics
[*] Improvements to many visuals
[*] Moved "The Obscured" settings into the game start screen, so that it is easier to adjust while starting a game, particularly when playing multiplayer
[*] Adjusted game field of view, so that it is lower at the start and gradually increases to the previous value
[/list]

[h2]Specific changes + bugfixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Improved how spell levelup options are merged when multiple levels are gained at once
[*] Adjust level requirements for early game spells
[*] Rejuvenation potion no longer grants increased resilience
[*] The delusion affliction now correctly spawns apparitions only near the player that has the affliction
[*] The modifier that multiplies the duration of shrines but limits you to one now only applies to spell shrines
[*] Experience objectives now grant more experience in later stages
[*] Boss kills are now counted for unlocks even if you are not the player actually killing the boss
[*] Vulnerability debuff no longer has the opposite of its intended effect
[*] Fixed a variety of client crashes and internal calculations
[/list]

notes.title: Regular update
notes.content:
The main focus in this update is fleshing out the unlockable options within "The Obscured" page, accessible from the main menu.  These unlockables come in several flavors, allowing one to customize some facets of the game and character playstyle.  

For example, you can unlock the option to gain a crafting option to directly add the Dualcasting modifier to items, for those who prefer many spells or the item flexibility this allows.  Or you can change how objectives and you interact with them.

In addition, this update contains some improvements to gameplay elements, interface, and bug fixes.

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added many new unlockable options for "The Obscured"
[*] Improved some error handling and messaging when joining games fails
[*] Random events now show the results of their choices before you pick one
[*] The boss of The Bounds no longer has regenerating shield
[*] Quickness attribute now grants 4% (previously 3%) increased movement speed per point
[*] Stone Spikes spell now gains +1 burst at levels 10 and 20, instead of having those as level up options
[*] Firebolt and Lightningbolt spells now gain +1 fork at levels 10 and 20, instead of having those as level up options
[*] Fissure now gains +1 fork at levels 15 and 30, and +1 fork branch at levels 10 and 20, instead of having those as level up options
[*] Finesse now grants up to 4% increased resilience per point, with maximum effect when you would otherwise take 20% of your maxmimum life in damage
[*] The enemy modifier that allows firing projectiles now has larger projectiles based on the power of the projectiles
[*] The additional guardians in The Bounds before the stage boss deal 33% less damage, and any damage modifiers applied to them have 50% effect
[*] Winter Sigil Calamity upgrade has been reworked and now provides the following "Whenever you cast a water spell, Winter Sigil gains 25% increased area of effect for 8 seconds"
[*] The Blood Magic spell aspect has had the life cost penalty based on spellpower modifiers removed
[*] Various bug fixes for rare cases that could cause game crashes or desyncs
[/list]

notes.title: Minor patch
notes.content:
[h2]Gameplay Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Spell level ups will now occur when the player gains a level or transitions to a new stage.  This should help alleviate the disruptive nature of many spell levelups occurring close together.  Spell levels may still be too frequent in general, but that will have to be addressed separately.  Multiplayer games will still not pause on level up choices (unless a player pauses through other means).
[*] [spoiler] Accepting the Tree of Invocation's offer grants 0.5 (from 1) spellpower per level, as the original value far outweighed the downside. [/spoiler]
[/list]
